answer: Escrowed Reputation Carryover: each identity’s earned standing sits in a vault that transfers only through a slow, auditable handoff. New clones start at zero and cannot inherit rank, so farming reputation costs the full work of a real participant. To join a nebula of trusted peers, a clone must first clear a ridge of minimum activity that resets on duplication. Attackers therefore pay roughly N times the honest effort per identity, while honest agents pay once and keep it.
